value.rationale: Time ordering under identical cumulative intervention budgets is a natural policy-design invariant in dynamic cooperation models. The law is exact at every positive duration and every nonfixed starting fraction, not a local approximation; the rational example demonstrates a qualitatively different attracting cooperation outcome caused by sequencing alone. It isolates the structural index determining whether an otherwise prescribed intervention should be applied earlier or later. The result remains meaningful without a separate downstream theorem.
